subtitle: Lesson 13 · Deployment Patterns

code:
Load balancer:
  spreads traffic across MULTIPLE instances
  of the SAME service

API gateway:
  routing, auth, and rate limiting
  BEFORE a request reaches your app code
caption: "Which healthy instance handles this?" vs. "should this request even get through?"
A proxy resource (/{proxy+}) forwards everything under a path to your backend's own routing.
The Prod stage gets its own invoke URL -- and its own rate/burst limits, enforced at the gateway.

eyebrow: Testing a call through the gateway
caption: A real test call, routed through the gateway's own Test tab, before any client code exists.

eyebrow: Why this matters more for an AI app
code:
Plain CRUD API:
  small, uniform requests

AI app:
  large prompt payloads
  slow, EXPENSIVE inference calls
  one careless client loop = a huge model bill
caption: Gateway-level rate limits catch this before it becomes an autoscaling bill or an outage.
